description: This header file defines internal functions related to ASN.1 object attributes for the ANSC framework, including functions for freeing, cloning, comparing, copying, encoding, and dumping ASN.1 attribute objects.

methods.name: AnscAsn1AttrFree
methods.description: Frees or deallocates resources associated with an ASN.1 attribute object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1AttrGetSizeOfEncodedTag
methods.description: Returns the size of the encoded ASN.1 tag for the attribute object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1AttrClone
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the ASN.1 attribute object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1AttrEqualsTo
methods.description: Compares two ASN.1 attribute objects for equality.

methods.name: AnscAsn1AttrCopyValueFrom
methods.description: Copies the value from a source ASN.1 attribute object to a destination object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1AttrEncodingData
methods.description: Encodes the ASN.1 attribute data, outputs encoded data and specifies if it's constructive.

methods.name: AnscAsn1AttrDump
methods.description: Dumps or outputs a textual representation of the ASN.1 attribute object into a buffer.
